candidates.summary: Cleanup admission rests on an honored credential and the caller's own record, so rejected or anonymous cleanup is new work.
Postgres shared state serializes authorization, inbox, idempotency, and claims across relay processes.
Cleanup admission classification: honored credential, same-origin form, gate CSRF, valid body and own record.
Verify synthetic MVP in a private Compose project without touching existing services or Tunnel.
Shared message and HTTP capacity keep new work bounded while reserving independent cleanup admission.
Cleanup removes expired payloads and retained metadata even when no client polls.
Load a private trial environment without exposing credentials in shell arguments; launch Codex CLI or Grok MCP.
Rate refusals expose the same rounded retry instant to JSON clients; shared admission spends the stable principal budget.
